title: Bridal Paragliding Tandem Flight & Flight School

services.name: Tandem Q&A
services.desc: Tandem flights from Bridal Falls and Mt Woodside (near Chilliwack, Agassiz); flight school training in Vancouver, Surrey, BC, Canada All students and tandem passengers call 604 418-7328 (at 8am) to confirm the weather, then we meet at the Bridal Falls Landing Zone (typically after 10am). From Vancouver, it takes about 1:20 hours to drive to the Bridal Landing Zone (HWY Exit135). See map. After introductions and a brief weather summary, we will start driving passengers and instructors up to launch (it’s about a 30 minute 4x4 drive up to 2500 feet elevation).
